This manual helps an operator carry out one concrete procedure step by step.

Replace this page with a short description of:

- what the procedure prepares or orchestrates;
- who should use this manual;
- what the operator should have before they begin;
- what visible project state should exist by the end.

Keep this page brief. The cover page should orient the reader, not duplicate the
full workflow.

## Before You Publish

Before you share this manual, make sure you have:

- renamed the manual to match the real procedure;
- replaced all placeholder text with project-specific instructions;
- added at least one real workflow page such as `10_page-setup-environment.qmd`;
- verified that each workflow page has exactly one prerequisite block, one or
  more procedure blocks, and exactly one check block.
